mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong household demand for housing, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity in financial markets, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 2.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1pp and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50k in one month indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decline > 0.1pp and PAYEMS increase > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline > 0.1pp and PAYEMS increase > 50k) occurs in more than 60% of cases where S&P 500 60-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion (indicated by rising industrial production), manufacturing output growth accelerates, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average and the economy is in the early-cycle expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicating inflationary pressures prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, reducing the present value of future equity cash flows and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising at a rate above 2% annually.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening in the residential sector, correlating with reduced consumer spending and lower corporate revenues, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST has been below 850,000 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 7.0% and declines by more than 0.2pp in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.1% in one month indicates strong housing market activity, correlating with robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 0.1% and HOUST increase > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS and HOUST both increasing > 0.1%) occurs in more than 60% of cases where S&P 500 5-day returns are negative.
